description: End-to-end latency tasks: goal submitted → ScreenPilot plans, highlights, the simulated user acts on the highlighted element, ScreenPilot verifies and declares the goal complete. One task per routing path that exists in the product. 'userInputs' is what the SIMULATED USER types when ScreenPilot highlights a text field (by element id); every other highlighted element is clicked. Pages are served at neutral paths.
